name: franco_sintetizador_masked_performance
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production CHIBI 16-bit pixel-art sprites. IMAGE1 is the EXACT TARGET CHARACTER MODEL: copy its head, chibi body, outfit, instrument, colors and identity throughout ALL frames. IMAGE2 is only the user STYLE/FORMAT reference; do NOT copy its archer, bow or hat. Optional IMAGE3 is physical mask geometry only. ONE SAME CHARACTER in entire sheet. Huge round head about45% of standing height, tiny torso, VERY SHORT STUBBY LEGS, chunky boots, about2.2heads tall, matching image1. Crisp square pixel clusters, dark outline, limited stepped shading. NO smooth illustration, gradients, 3D, photorealism or elongated anatomy. Real TRANSPARENT PNG alpha, no background, checkerboard, shadows, floor, labels, text or grid.
Exactly EIGHT COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS on a landscape canvas, 32 FULL BODY sprites. Row1front/down, row2LEFT profile, row3BACK/up, row4RIGHT profile. Eight consecutive temporal poses per row, same action, constant scale, common pivot and baseline. Entire figure/prop/maskspikes inside each equal invisiblecell with generous padding. Instrument fixed to straps, consistent anatomy, same head size and SHORT legs in all32poses. In back view front keyboard is naturally hidden, not moved onto back. Clear anticipation/action/recovery. No visual effects; game adds effects separately.
CHARACTER: FRANCO SINTETIZADOR: brown skin, voluminous DARK CURLY HAIR, subtle chin beard, cyan/magenta headphones, purple jacket with ORANGE/GOLD shoulders and gold chains, tiny dark legs and boots. Compact SYNTH KEYBOARD diagonally strapped to FRONT waist with purple strap. No cap, no drumsticks, no drum, no bow.
VARIANT: WITH MASK WORN ON HEAD in ALL poses: ivory stitched cloth helmet, long radial spikes, central stitched seam, circular black goggles, lower cutout exposing actual mouth/chin. Mask follows head when rolling/bending/falling; never floats or vanishes.
ACTION: Eight-frame performance loop: both hands play a melodic KEYBOARD phrase, fingers visibly move on black/ivory keys, right hand briefly touches synth knob then returns, head nods, short knees bounce. Same keyboard and face in every frame. Eighth flows into first.
